candidates.snippet:
A crucial forward-deployed presence ⚓🇺🇸 

The @US7thFleet, through the @SurfaceWarriors aboard USS Mustin, demonstrates our unwavering commitment to a #FreeAndOpenIndoPacific. 

#SteadyCourse | #StrongResolve https://t.co/i9eN9XkEAZ

It's a scenic view & the sight of dedicated allies working as one. Great training with our partners for Exercise #PacificVanguard 2026. Together, we are committed to a stable and secure maritime environment. #StrongerTogether https://t.co/HkzetpuaMh

Watch the impressive "Swift Intruders" of ACU-5 in action. The Sailors & their LCACs are a critical link for the joint Navy-Marine Corps force, enabling us to move, fight, and sustain operations from ship to shore anywhere in the Indo-Pacific. 

#BlueGreenTeam #USPacificFleet
